entities.summary: Shigeru Saeki (b. 1969-06-24, Toyama Prefecture) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Toyama Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
